name: Sythera
storyline: The story picks up after Nameless Hero's party departure to the Halls of Irdorath, during the voyage they got separated by the mysterious dark forces. Washed ashore in Sythera, the Nameless Hero sets out in search of his comrades. Sythera was the last battlefield of the gods in ancient times. And it shall happen again. But first we need to run some errands and help locals with their problems.
summary:
Sythera is a german total conversion mod for Gothic 2 Night of the Raven, which tells the story of Nameless Hero, even more exhausted than before, where he will have to regain his strength and climb the hierarchy again. Project is a demo.
Features:
- full profesional voice over in polish
- over 90 NPCs, more than half of them with dialogues
- over 50 quests
- completely new world
- chapter dependent respawn
- three chapters, about 18 - 20h of gameplay, max 15 lvl can be reached
